sceneConcept: A quiet thirty-four-year-old Chinese Sword Pavilion member stands alone against a transparent background. Very long straight black hair is tied into a low ponytail by one narrow weathered red cord. His dark brown eyes and refined face remain calm and unreadable. He wears a contemporary charcoal-black long jacket with a restrained mandarin collar and concealed fasteners over a dark shirt, straight trousers and flat black boots. His hands rest loosely together at the waist, displaying unusually long relaxed fingers. Soft even frontal studio light preserves the silent silhouette. Visual refresh: a charcoal kimono beneath a weathered black long coat, tied with the old red hair cord.
naturalLanguageDetail: A quiet slender thirty-four-year-old Chinese man with very long straight black hair tied low by one narrow weathered red cord stands in a contemporary charcoal-black mandarin-collar long jacket, holding his own hands loosely together at the waist to show unusually long relaxed fingers under soft even frontal studio light; a charcoal kimono beneath a weathered black long coat, tied with the old red hair cord; the portrait is framed from head to mid-thigh in a strict cowboy shot, with lower legs and feet outside the image.
